Mod.title: Girls' Frontline 2: Door Kickers
Mod.author: beanpuppy
Mod.description:
[h2]Girls' Frontline 2: Door Kickers[/h2] [code]Commander, you're here. Good.
We've been assigned operations in the contaminated zones. The areas are still unstable; Hostile forces have moved in, taken hostages, fortified positions. Someone needs to clear them out.
I know it's dangerous work, but... we'll be careful. Just give us the orders and we'll see it through.
What do you say, Commander?[/code]
[h3]Overview[/h3] This mod brings tactical dolls from Girls' Frontline 2: Exilium into Door Kickers 2 as fully playable units. Each doll has their 3D model converted from the original game, along with their signature weapon, and voice lines.
Every weapon has been individually tuned and each weapon class plays differently. Dolls also come with custom armour, helmets, and alternative ammo types, with new equipment being added regularly.
Some dolls have alternate costumes available. This requires the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3286103408]In-Game Camouflage Selector[/url] mod loaded before this mod. Without the camo selector mod, dolls will use their default outfit.
[h3]Units[/h3] [b]Task Force DEFY:[/b] Alva, Voymastina [b]H.I.D.E 404:[/b] Klukai, Mechty, Andoris, Belka, Leva, Lenna, Vector [b]Zucchero Café:[/b] Springfield, Makiatto, Centaureissi, Sharkry [b]Groza Squad:[/b] Groza, Nemesis, Krolik, Colphne, Vepley [b]Elmo Combined Echelon:[/b] Peritya, Sabrina, Qiuhua, Peri, Florence, Nikketa, Helen, Lewis [b]Frostfall Squad:[/b] Qiongju, Cheeta, Tololo, Lind [b]Monsoon Squad:[/b] Daiyan, Jiangyu, Zhaohui, Faye [b]POL-03 Security Divisions:[/b] Mosin-Nagant, Nagant, Ksenia, Papasha
[i]Note: Only dolls currently available in GFL2 are/will be included.[/i]
To see our roadmap, visit the [url=https://trello.com/b/y77gdE1R/girl-kickers]Trello board.[/url] Contribute on [url=https://github.com/antistrategie/girl-kickers]GitHub[/url] or join the [url=https://discord.gg/XcfYGmxvde]Discord[/url] for discussion and feedback.
[h3]Known Limitations[/h3] DK2 expects uniform model sizes, so dolls with unusual heights or builds may have minor visual issues. Models are optimised for the default top-down view and any issues only visible in freelook are expected.
